setupAndDescriptors.PASS: Configured session, supported modes/bands and Entry/Log descriptors checked.

entryAndStoredFields.PASS: Committed fixture fields, parsed call, timestamp and raw exchanges checked in SQLite.

expectedPointsMultipliersScore.PASS: First-contact points, multipliers and total match explicit fixture constants; not sponsor certification.

invalidInputAtomicity.PASS: Invalid required call rejected without row insertion or draft loss.

invalidExchangeAtomicity.PASS: Malformed required exchange rejected without row insertion or draft loss.
invalidExchangeAtomicity.NOT APPLICABLE: Pinned contract permits incomplete/free-text exchanges; required callsign rejection tested

duplicateClassification.PASS: Repeated call classification matches the plugin duplicate contract in this fixture.

repeatContact.PASS: Repeated contact committed and score captured; family fixtures cover applicable duplicate rules.

distinctCallRepeatedExchange.PASS: Distinct call with repeated geography/exchange has the expected per-contact points.

basicAnalytics.PASS: Prepared snapshot and paged contacts retain all three fixture contacts and calls.

exportContents.PASS: Every advertised export read and decoded; contact fields and available headers validated by the checker.

correction.PASS: Received report corrected while retaining contact identity, time and historical sent serial/exchange.

deletion.PASS: Original and distinct-call rows deleted; retained contact and explicit score expectations checked.

persistenceAndSerial.PASS: Closed and reopened host retains complete rows, score and reserved serial.

currentReactEntry.PASS: Current workspace and detached Entry commit via real Python JSONL; native/output services are simulated.

nativePythonLane.PASS: All-fixture XCTest creates, commits, reads and reopens through the actual Swift PythonContestLane; no GUI launch.

multiplierTracker.UNVERIFIED: No tested per-plugin detailed worked/needed view; plugin total remains authoritative.
multiplierTracker.NOT APPLICABLE: Utility has no required contest multiplier view.

advancedAnalytics.UNVERIFIED: Basic snapshot/page checked; credited history and every advanced view are not certified for this plugin.

recordedVoiceOutput.NOT APPLICABLE: No SSB mode is advertised by this definition.
recordedVoiceOutput.UNVERIFIED: Voice output/hardware not exercised by disposable catalogue tests.

cwOutput.UNVERIFIED: Existing simulated owners/family tests only; no per-plugin transmitter acceptance.
cwOutput.NOT APPLICABLE: No CW mode is advertised by this definition.

digitalOutput.NOT APPLICABLE: No digital output capability advertised by catalogue.
digitalOutput.UNVERIFIED: Digital logging capability does not certify an external modem or transport.

recorder.UNVERIFIED: Shared recorder fixtures exist; catalogue tests do not record audio or accept station playback.

multiOperator.UNVERIFIED: Shared replication fixtures are separate; no live per-plugin network acceptance.

hardwareAcceptance.UNVERIFIED: No installed-app, radio, RF/PTT, audio route or station-setting operation performed.

currentSponsorRules.UNVERIFIED: Pinned integration and explicit fixture arithmetic do not certify the current organizer edition.
currentSponsorRules.NOT APPLICABLE: Utility definition; no sponsor submission certification required.

brazilUFIdentity.UNVERIFIED: Brazil UF is counted only when explicitly established. Automatic received-UF acquisition is absent; affected contacts expose scoringComplete=false, partial-score UI and Cabrillo SOAPBOX limitation. RTC/manual or automatic score payloads refuse scoring_incomplete. Operator UF review remains required.

featureReasonResolution: Each feature has an explicit status. Resolve its reason from featureReasons[feature][status], overridden by that entry's featureReasonOverrides[feature].
scoreContract: Plugin points/show_mults/calc_score with documented host scoreRevision overlays; no universal reconstructed formula.
familyTestResolution: Entry familyTests contains indexes into the global familyTestIDs list; the primary source fixture remains a full ID in fixture.
callbackReference: Each source.callbacks value is a one-based line in that entry's source.path; multiplierDimensionsAndScope describes its executable scope, including documented host overlays.
